content.title: Rain-City Walk | Gait Clock, Depth Landmarks and Continuous Scale
content.summary: An adult signal marshal crosses a rainy port city toward one beacon gate. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One vehicle identity and one route remain continuous. + Wheel motion agrees with camera and road direction. + Every camera handoff preserves a registered landmark. + The orbit reveals rather than changes geography. + The final wide frame proves the completed path.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult signal marshal enters a rain-lit port avenue carrying one folded survey pole. Hand off to a side-rear track as two service vehicles and three drones cross separate depth layers. Stop at the beacon gate; the marshal plants the survey pole once and faces the still-closed entrance.
required_anchors: One clearly adult subject and one route persist.
Walking cadence clocks every camera handoff.
No unobserved victory or combat is invented.
The final threshold is visibly connected to the opening destination.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject and one route persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject and one route persist."

invariants.rule: Walking cadence clocks every camera handoff.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Walking cadence clocks every camera handoff."

invariants.rule: Environmental layers increase scale without resetting geography.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Environmental layers increase scale without resetting geography."

invariants.rule: No unobserved victory or combat is invented.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "No unobserved victory or combat is invented."

invariants.rule: The final threshold is visibly connected to the opening destination.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final threshold is visibly connected to the opening destination."
